question: The ICC Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup 2025 was played in Malaysia in January 2025. Which team won the tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• This tournament marked a significant milestone for women’s cricket, encouraging **young talent** and promoting the sport globally.
 
• **India** emerged victorious in the tournament, showcasing exceptional performances throughout.
 
• The Indian team demonstrated consistent dominance, excelling in both **batting** and **bowling** departments.
 
• The win further cemented India’s position as a leading nation in **women’s cricket**, inspiring aspiring players worldwide.
